comment: Which RPCs an anonymous Supabase account (the phone: role authenticated, JWT claim is_anonymous = true) may run. Every other RPC in the *rpc-contract.json files that is granted to authenticated refuses with the code below, via the guard in supabase/migrations/*_s5_anonymous_guard.sql (create_pair_code carries the same refusal in its own body; the two text-returning sync RPCs, replace_plan_snapshot and heartbeat, return the code as text, all others as jsonb {"code": ...}). Read by supabase/tests/anonymous_guard.static.test.ts; it documents the rule and does not prove it (V5-2).
